rules.name: Old Rust toolchains
rules.description: Uninstalls older, beta, custom, or alternate-host Rust toolchains; the latest stable and nightly plus active, default, and project-pinned toolchains are kept.
rules.sideEffect: Unreferenced beta, custom, and alternate-host toolchains are uninstalled and may need manual restoration.

rules.name: pip
rules.description: Downloaded Python package and wheel cache.

rules.name: Playwright browsers
rules.description: Downloaded test browsers; Playwright downloads them again when required.

rules.name: pnpm
rules.description: Downloaded pnpm metadata and package cache.

rules.name: Rustup downloads
rules.description: Incomplete and cached toolchain downloads; installed Rust toolchains are preserved.

rules.name: Unity asset cache
rules.description: Downloaded and generated Unity asset cache; projects are preserved and missing data is regenerated.
rules.sideEffect: Unity may spend significant time importing or downloading assets again.

rules.name: Unreal Engine derived data

rules.sideEffect: Unreal Engine must rebuild derived data, which can make the next launch significantly slower.

rules.name: uv
rules.description: Downloaded Python packages and build artifacts managed by uv; environments and projects are preserved.

rules.name: Yarn
rules.description: Downloaded Yarn package cache.

rules.description: Compiled graphics shaders that Windows recreates when needed.

rules.name: Error reports
rules.description: Archived and queued Windows Error Reporting data.

rules.name: GPU shader caches
rules.description: NVIDIA, AMD and Intel compiled shader caches; graphics drivers recreate them.

rules.name: Microsoft Store app temporary files
rules.description: Temporary-state folders from Store apps; local settings and offline data are preserved.

rules.name: Recycle Bin
rules.description: Permanently removes files currently stored in the Recycle Bin.

rules.name: Temporary files
rules.description: Temporary files created by your account and applications.

rules.description: Explorer previews and icons that are regenerated automatically.

rules.name: Windows component cleanup
rules.description: Microsoft DISM cleanup that preserves update uninstall support.

rules.name: Windows temporary files
rules.description: Temporary working files created by Windows services.

rules.name: Windows Update downloads
rules.description: Downloaded update installers; Windows downloads them again if required.
rules.sideEffect: Windows may need to download update files again.
